purpose: Single-value form control for free text, email, passwords, numbers, and selections rendered as a labeled field.

variants.name: email
variants.usage: Email addresses; enables appropriate keyboard and autocomplete.

variants.name: password
variants.usage: Secrets; masked, with autocomplete hints for password managers.

variants.name: select
variants.usage: Choice among a small closed set of options.

variants.name: checkbox
variants.usage: Boolean opt-in. Never pre-checked for consent.

props.name: name
props.description: Field name within the enclosing form.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label; programmatically associated with the control.

props.name: error
props.description: Inline validation message; announced via role=alert.

accessibility.requirement: Every input has a visible, programmatically associated label. Placeholder is never the label.
Validation errors are textual, adjacent to the field, and announced to assistive technology.
Fields collecting personal data declare an autocomplete purpose.
Input text is at least font.size.md to avoid mobile zoom traps.

constraints.rule: select variant requires at least 2 options.
Consent checkboxes must not default to checked.

ast.name: email
ast.label: Email address
ast.error: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
